component.name: Mason Agent
component.summary: A coding workspace that runs on your own local models

description.p: Add a project, decide what the agent may do, and review every change before you keep it. Mason Agent talks only to models running on this computer.

ul.li: Sessions per project, with each tool call shown as it finishes
Read-only, review, workspace-edit and sandboxed Auto permission modes
Diffs of every change, with undo and redo of a request's edits
Finds, downloads and runs GGUF models with llama.cpp
